clips.secondaryTranscriptReview:
Here is the verbatim transcript of the audio recording, followed by notes on pronunciation and pricing details.

---

### **Verbatim Transcript**

> "You can choose to manage the music yourself, or have BM Asia take care of it. Self-service costs 15 US dollars per zone per month. If you prefer an annual plan, it is 150 US dollars per zone per year. Both self-service plans include the app's features, and you manage your own playlists and schedules. 
> 
> For a hands-off service, BM Asia manages your music and radio station for 260 US dollars per zone per year, available on annual plans only. Our music design team selects and refreshes the playlists and schedules assigned to each zone, including seasonal changes. That service also includes 24/7 technical support and a dedicated account manager. Additional AI generation credits are charged separately. 
> 
> Everyone receives ongoing app updates, whichever plan they choose. The difference is who looks after your music and radio. 
> 
> You can try self-service free for 14 days on one zone. It asks for a card, with no charge when it starts. If BM Asia arranges your trial, no card is needed. Larger groups can arrange custom contracts and local invoicing, and no dedicated player box is required."

---

### **Pronunciation & Audio Observations**

* **Company Name:** Consistently pronounced as **"BM Asia"** (`B-M-Asia`).
* **Prompt-Specific Phrases ("music by", "regional", "review the"):** None of these phrases ("music by", "regional", "review the") appear anywhere in this audio recording. 
* **Pronunciation / Speech Quality:** 
  * The narration is clear, natural, and synthesized/recorded cleanly with smooth pacing.
  * No cut-off words, unnatural pauses, or ambiguous pronunciations were detected.

---

### **Pricing Breakdown**

* **Self-Service (Monthly):** 15 US dollars per zone per month
* **Self-Service (Annual):** 150 US dollars per zone per year
* **Hands-Off Managed Service (Annual):** 260 US dollars per zone per year
